notes.title: Public Enemy is coming...
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/LkqktyNGWO3qlBd2cG/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]Here is [i][b]Public Enemy: Revolution Simulator![/b][/i][/h1]

This game was made during a game jam some years ago. We like it so much that we wanted to share it for free on Steam!

This short game is about dictatorship, but made in a funny way. [b]Stick fishes[/b] on the back of the guards, [b]make graffiti's[/b] in the city and [b]break the statues[/b] of the government to raise the people, without being caught!

[h1]Wishlist it now to be ready for the Release Day![/h1]
This game will be totally free! 

See ya on Discord!
http://discord.gg/a3qtypa

Concretely,
Concrete Games Team
